title: ExposureIQ
description: A multi-agent LLM pipeline that scores 100k+ earnings-call segments for corporate-integrity signal, paired with an evaluation harness that attributes every error to the specific agent that caused it.

title: ThemeScope
description: A multi-agent research system that scores S&P 1500 companies on conduct and AI exposure from earnings calls and 10-Ks — with every number traceable back to the sentence that produced it. Built on the ExposureIQ pipeline.

title: Contextual Thesaurus
description: A domain-aware synonym engine powered by Word2Vec embeddings trained on financial corpora. Querying "liquid" returns cash, assets, solvent — not fluid, watery, wet.
